publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("Europe's day of change", by Gideon Rachman), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.

entries.quote: There will be a period of up to two months—varying from country to country—in which old and new currencies will circulate side by side. But by March it will be euros only.
entries.subject: Euro cash changeover

entries.quote: In 2002 that issue will fade and the euro may break back through the symbolic level of parity with the dollar.
entries.subject: Euro-dollar parity

entries.quote: Worryingly the euro zone’s big three—Italy, Germany and France—could all be in line for reprimands in 2002.
entries.subject: Stability and Growth Pact reprimands

notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article.
